chunks: About a man who took a bird out from Makkah to al-Kūfah, so he said: "He must return it to Makkah."

key_terms.الْكُوفَةِ: al-Kūfah, the destination to which the bird was taken
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man, the subject of the legal case
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurārah, the narrator who posed the question
key_terms.طَيْرًا: a bird taken from the sacred area
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah, the sacred sanctuary from which the bird was taken
key_terms.يَرُدُّهُ: he must return it, indicating the legal obligation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on taking a bird from Makkah to another city?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a bird taken from Makkah to al-Kūfah. The Imam عليه السلام rules that it must be returned to Makkah, reflecting the sanctity and legal protections associated with the Haram.
